modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Goodwin (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Goodwin suffered a calf injury in Monday's 116-113 loss to the Warriors. His next chance to return will come Thursday versus Orlando. In the meantime, Luke Kennard could be on the floor more than usual.

injury.shortComment: Fleming is out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a sprained left ankle.
injury.detail: Fleming is missing the front end of this back-to-back set with the injury. His next opportunity to suit up arrives Thursday, when the Suns host the Magic.
